mapper.select: SELECT id, username, full_name, email, region_abbreviation, phone_number, avatar_url, status, department_id, position_id, created_at, updated_at FROM "user" WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.full_name, u.email, u.region_abbreviation, u.phone_number, u.avatar_url, u.status, u.department_id, d.name AS department_name, u.position_id, p.name AS position_name, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN department d ON u.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN position p ON u.position_id = p.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
